Game Overview

The Scythian Warrior puts players into a action experience centered on embark on a vengeance-fueled journey as Aryasp, a formidable warrior in a dynamic 3D world. Engage in strategic battles, manage your health, and solve puzzles to overcome enemies. Use cunning and skill to exact revenge on those who devastated your tribe. Achieve victory, for Scythia's honor!
